name: Northwest First Marches - v768 House Spacing Fixed

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.title: Rivercross Quartermaster
npcs.dialogue: Fresh supplies for the road. Take only what you need and bring back what the wilds can spare.

npcs.name: Serah
npcs.title: Scholar of Embers
npcs.dialogue: Magic is a discipline, not a birthright. Learn carefully and decide for yourself how far to take it.

npcs.name: Corvin
npcs.title: Rivercross Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: Your stored goods are safe here while the roads remain less certain.

npcs.name: Edrik
npcs.title: Rivercross Artisan
npcs.dialogue: Good tools and patient hands open more paths than any title ever could.

npcs.name: Hald
npcs.title: Reedmere Crafter
npcs.dialogue: Out here, a good craft is worth more than a polished title.

npcs.name: Orren
npcs.title: Greyford Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: Leave what you do not need on the road. It will be here when you return.

npcs.name: Elin
npcs.title: Greyford Merchant
npcs.dialogue: Greyford is small, but the road keeps these shelves useful.

npcs.name: Toren
npcs.title: Mossford Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: Store your valuables before heading east. The marsh keeps what careless travelers drop.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.title: Mossford Merchant
npcs.dialogue: Most travelers stop here before the road turns wetter and less forgiving.

npcs.name: Ilah
npcs.title: Fenwatch Ember Scholar
npcs.dialogue: Even damp country cannot smother a disciplined ember.

npcs.name: Vesa
npcs.title: Fenwatch Artisan
npcs.dialogue: Reeds, hide, copper and patience. Out here we make use of whatever survives the marsh.

npcs.name: Bren
npcs.title: Stonebrook Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: The southern roads are long. Leave what you do not need here.

npcs.name: Orsa
npcs.title: Stonebrook Merchant
npcs.dialogue: Stonebrook sits where the forest road meets the old southern pass. Supplies matter more here than gossip.

npcs.name: Erin
npcs.title: Blackfen Ember Scholar
npcs.dialogue: The fen swallows sound and flame alike, but a controlled ember still answers.

npcs.name: Maela
npcs.title: Pinewatch Artisan
npcs.dialogue: Mountain roads punish weak tools. Learn to make something that survives them.

npcs.name: Garr
npcs.title: Highpass Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: If the pass takes you, at least your stored goods will still be here.

npcs.name: Sella
npcs.title: Highpass Merchant
npcs.dialogue: Beyond Highpass the roads stop pretending to be safe.

npcs.name: Orik
npcs.title: Ravenmoor Ember Scholar
npcs.dialogue: There are old lights in this moor that are not fire. Learn the difference.

npcs.name: Vera
npcs.title: Ravenmoor Artisan
npcs.dialogue: Wet ground ruins poor workmanship quickly. Make it properly or make it twice.

npcs.name: Elor
npcs.title: Ravenmere Ember Scholar
npcs.dialogue: Some lights in Ravenmere are older than the roads. Do not mistake every glow for fire.

npcs.name: Isa
npcs.title: Ravenmere Artisan
npcs.dialogue: The marsh wastes careless work. Build for rain, mud and long travel.

npcs.name: Varn
npcs.title: Ironvale Depotkeeper
npcs.dialogue: Store what matters. The old roads have a habit of taking the rest.

npcs.name: Nella
npcs.title: Ironvale Merchant
npcs.dialogue: Ironvale is the last easy place to rest before the old southern roads.
